concerns.text: Task T038 (Learning Curve Power Analysis) is marked as uncompleted `[ ]`. The spec (SC-004) and plan (Phase 2, Step 1) explicitly require learning curve analysis for sample sizes <50 to measure sufficiency. Without this task being implemented, the project cannot satisfy SC-004 or the Edge Case handling for N<50.

Task T039 (Streaming/Chunking for large files) is marked as uncompleted `[ ]`. The plan (Technical Context) specifies a 7GB RAM constraint on GitHub Actions. Without this task, the pipeline risks OOM failures on large metabolomics datasets, violating the plan's performance goals and Constitution Principle III (Data Hygiene/Constraints).

Task T040 (InChIKey alignment failure handling) is marked as uncompleted `[ ]`. The spec Edge Cases ask 'How does system handle metabolites that cannot be aligned...'. While T015-impl mentions logging, T040 is the specific task to enforce the <10 metabolite halt. Its absence leaves the Edge Case unimplemented.

Task T041 (Class Imbalance handling) is marked as uncompleted `[ ]`. The spec Edge Cases ask 'What happens when the hold-out set contains no positive samples'. T041 is the designated task to raise `ClassImbalanceError`. Without it, the pipeline may crash or produce invalid metrics on imbalanced data.

Task T043 (KEGG API fallback/retry) is marked as uncompleted `[ ]`. The spec Edge Cases and US-3 require pathway mapping. T043 handles API failures. Without it, the pipeline halts on transient network errors, violating Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) as the run is not robust to external service volatility.

Task T021a saves `correlation_analysis_raw.json` but SC-002 requires measuring correlations 'with Benjamini-Hochberg FDR correction'. The filename 'raw' and lack of explicit mention of saving the *corrected* p-values or the FDR-adjusted list in the task description creates ambiguity on whether the SC-002 requirement is fully captured in the artifact.
